sentences.text: The petitioner is also claiming compensation to the tune of Rs. One Crore for the harassment suffered by him.
2. The wife of the present petitioner lodged the FIR against him and other family members at Police Station Balaghat.

The Superintendent of Police, Balaghat sent the case-diary of the case to the Police Station Malharganj, Indore where it was registered at Crime No. 485/2018 on 16.10.2018 u/s.
498-A, 294, 323, 506, 34 of the IPC and u/s. 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against the petitioner and three others.
The petitioner was arrested on 12.12.2018 at 11.30 am. and produced before the Court of Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Indore on 13.123.2018.
The police sought 13 days' remand which was granted by the Court on the same day.
Later on, the petitioner filed an application u/s. 437 of the Cr.P.C. which came to be allowed and he was released from the jail.

In the criminal case, the petitioner filed an application u/s. 197 of the Cr.P.C. Seeking prosecution against police officers u/s. 166-A, 167, 219, 220, 330, 383, 384, 388, 389, 211, 363, 342, 352, 120-B, 295,
452, 499, 500, 323, 504, 506, 420 of the IPC.
The petitioner also sent a legal notice and now filed the present petition before this Court.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was handcuffed by the police which has defamed his reputation in the public.
There is no such material on record to establish that the petitioner was handcuffed.
Rather, the Court has restrained the police that he be not handcuffed.
The petitioner has filed an application u/s. 197 of the Cr.P.C. before the JMFC.
Para 12 and and 13 of the application are reproduced below :
The petitioner is seeking the relief from a Court with the aforesaid mindset that he being a 'Brahmin' was compelled to take a bail from a Judge because of registration of the FIR by the police.
